title: First release
summary: Plan your day, keep habit streaks, and collect Treasures as you go.

sections.heading: My Chronicle
changes: Add one-off tasks and repeating habits, organize them into lists, and check off today’s tasks.
Use the task timer and pop it out in browsers that support it.
Follow the Getting Started checklist or open Q&A for help.

sections.heading: Progress and rewards
changes: See your mood history and weekly gifts on the Progress calendar, browse collected gifts under My Treasures.
Earn coins from habits and spend them to repair an eligible missed day.

sections.heading: Settings
changes: Set your time zone, choose when the week starts, and customize your background.
Manage your username-and-password account and save your recovery code.
